paper.title_en: Standard Model Effective Field Theory and Oscillons
paper.abstract_en: We show that the inclusion of a dimension-six operator in the Higgs potential has a dramatic impact on the stability of oscillons in the $SU(2)$ bosonic sector of the Standard Model, extending their lifetime by orders of magnitude. This happens for the physical value of the ratio between the Higgs and W boson masses, $m_H/m_W=1.556$ and for the dimension-six operator $O_6 = (Φ^\dagger Φ)^3$ whose coupling constant is below the current upper bound.
